Title: Minimum checks
Text: 1. All four corner crop paths exist. 2. The thumbnail path exists. 3. `OUTPUT_PATH` has a `.md` extension and its parent exists. 4. Exactly one output file is written. 5. Frontmatter contains `drawing_type: DRAWING_SET` and `extraction_target: titleblock_index`. 6. `status` is one of `SUCCESS`, `NO_TITLEBLOCK`, `FAILED`, `FAILED_INPUTS`. 7. `finding_count` is `1` for `SUCCESS` and `0` for `NO_TITLEBLOCK`. 8. Body table columns match the canonical schema. 9. `confidence` is `high`, `medium`, or `low` when a row is emitted.

Title: Failure posture
Text: - Invalid inputs produce `FAILED_INPUTS` and a failure stub. - A readable page without a titleblock produces `NO_TITLEBLOCK`, not `FAILED`. - Unreadable fields are `TBD`.
